BICAS WTF Ride

Tucson, AZ · Social

Women / trans / femmeLGBTQ+Beginner friendlyNo-drop

BICAS WTF Ride is a social group ride in Tucson, AZ. It rolls last Monday of the month at 7:00 pm from BICAS. About 10 miles, no-drop, party pace.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: no-drop, party pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @bicastucson the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the BICAS WTF Ride group ride

A monthly night ride for women, trans and femme riders, run out of the BICAS community bike shop. It grows out of the weekly WTF workshop, which runs Mondays 3–7 pm. The June edition is a Pride ride. All WTF-identifying folks welcome.
